title: NYC Noise Calls Doubled To 700,000
closing: More calls mean city noise is reaching more homes.
question: What's loudest near you?

segments.say: Noise makes up 18 percent of NYC complaints, crowding out nearly every other problem.
NYC noise complaints reached 700,000 in 2023, doubling since 2010.
NYC receives 1,918 noise calls daily, so quiet rarely reaches the complaint line.
